timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,528 KRW/USD (June average); risk of 1,600+ KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak (high KRW per USD), making your monthly $2,000 conversion expensive. News indicates further weakening pressure ahead—analysts warn the rate could breach 1,600 KRW/USD if interest rate hikes don't materialize, with only modest long-term recovery expected by year-end (1,430–1,530 range).

TIP: If possible, consider dollar-cost averaging smaller amounts or waiting for signs of won strength (rate dipping toward 1,430) before converting your full monthly allocation.
